verdict.rationale: Angular is a web UI framework and development platform, not an agent or AI application that consumes tools. Plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains only a generic mention of "AI-forward resources and integrations" and an llms.txt file, and neither shows Angular acting as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
